Priya Desai: Heads up — candidate Marisol called, running late due to taxi traffic. New ETA ~11:50 (was 10:30). Also requested ASL interpreter for interviews and wheelchair-accessible room. Can we coordinate quickly?
Ethan Lee: I'll cover the tech logistics. Which room should we use? Needs good sight lines for interpreter.
Priya Desai: Quiet Room F has open floor plan and big table. Also please make sure the camera can face both candidate and panel.
Rosa Kim: I'm on interpreter booking. Reaching out to Interpreter Services now — will confirm availability for 11:45-14:00.
Interpreter Services: Confirmed ASL interpreter (Vanessa R.) available 11:30-14:30. Booking ID INT-4932.
Tom Baker: Facilities Bot — can we set Quiet Room F to wheelchair access path and remove one chair to create clear space? Also ensure microphone on table for hearing assist.
Facilities Bot: Quiet Room F reserved 11:15	6:00. Wheelchair path verified: elevator flagged, door width OK. Portable lapel mic and speaker requested and scheduled.
Priya Desai: Thank you. Ethan — can you prep a laptop (Mac) with HDMI + latest browser and set camera to front-facing. Also leave a printed one-pager with interview loop.
Ethan Lee: Will place MacBook loaner in Quiet Room F by 11:10 with HDMI, USB-C adapter, and sticky with WiFi creds: `WiFi: Redwood-Guest | PW: visit2026`
Rosa Kim: Interpreter Vanessa will check in at reception at 11:20. Reception Bot, PLEASE expect interpreter and candidate around 11:30-11:50.
Reception Bot: Noted. Interpreter and candidate will be prioritized for badge printing. Please have photo IDs ready at check-in.
Priya Desai: Also note dietary requirement: candidate is pescatarian. Please order lunch accordingly for 12:30. Budget on file.
Interpreter Services: Vanessa R. confirmed dietary need acknowledged. Arrival ETA 11:20.
Tom Baker: I'll place wheelchair access signage and clear path at 11:05. Microphone & speaker placed on table by 11:10.
Ethan Lee: Quick test: I'll join Quiet Room F at 11:25 to test camera framing and audio with Vanessa. Remote fallback link also set if panelists need to join remotely: https://meet.redwood.ai/onsite-fallback
Rosa Kim: Calendar invites updated with ASL flag and interpreter name. Panelists notified to speak clearly and face candidate when possible.
Priya Desai: Recruiter note: please send candidate the accessibility confirmation and arrival instructions (entrance A, check-in at reception, bring ID). I'll DM Marisol now.
Reception Bot: Badge printing queue currently light. Prioritizing Interpreter Services and candidate as requested.
Ethan Lee: AV test complete at 11:28. Camera framing good for both participant and interpreter. Mic levels set.
Rosa Kim: Vanessa checked in at reception at 11:21 and is heading to Quiet Room F. Candidate texted: "On my way, ETA 11:50, thanks for accommodating."
Tom Baker: Wheelchair path clear. Signage in place. Microphone battery full.
Priya Desai: Everything looks lined up. If anything changes we'll switch Marisol to remote and have Vanessa interpret over the call. But hoping for in-person.
Interpreter Services: Vanessa on-site and ready. Booking INT-4932 complete.
Reception Bot: Candidate and interpreter checked in at 11:47. Badges issued.
Rosa Kim: Live note: panelists remember to face Marisol and pause between sentences for interpretation. Thanks all.
Ethan Lee: MacBook loaner in Quiet Room F at 11:35 with sticky: `WiFi: Redwood-Guest`
Priya Desai: Candidate arrived, signed NDA, meeting starting 12:00 now with interpreter present. Closing thread — great teamwork.
